name: istanbul-match
description: İstanbul Match — Hacivat & Karagöz's Istanbul match-3 tour

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:release: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode release && cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync:release && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.simulate: rolldown scripts/simulate.ts --platform node --format esm -o node_modules/.cache/simulate.mjs --logLevel warn && node node_modules/.cache/simulate.mjs
